defs.def: a person who has been chosen to speak or vote for sb else or on behalf of a group 代表
a person who works for a company and travels around selling its products 销售代表；销售代理；代销人

ex.s: They first found 10 overweight and inactive but otherwise healthy young men, whose lifestyles are, for better and worse, representative of those of most of us.
ex.t: 为了找出答案，英国科学家进行了一项研究。

defs.def: a person chosen to take the place of sb else 代表；代表他人者
a person who is typical of a particular group 典型人物；代表性人物
(in the US) a member of the House of Representatives, the Lower House of Congress; a member of the House of Representatives in the lower house of a state parliament （美国）众议院议员

ex.s: More researchers, policymakers and representatives from the food industry must learn to look beyond their direct lines of responsibility and adopt a systems approach.
ex.t: 更多研究人员、政策制定者和食品行业代表必须学会超越其直接责任范围，采用系统思维的方法。

defs.def: typical of a particular group of people 典型的；有代表性的

ex.s: In 2017, representatives from Peking University, Tsinghua University, Nankai University and Yunnan Normal University gathered to commemorate the 80th anniversary of its founding.
ex.t: 2017年，来自北京大学、清华大学、南开大学和云南师范大学的代表齐聚一堂，纪念其成立80周年。

ex.s: You might want to: • relax and make eye contact with the audience • use gestures when appropriate • vary your tone and volume 1 Select a representative from the group to deliver the speech to the class.
ex.t: 你或许想要：• 放松并与听众保持眼神交流 • 在适当的时候使用手势 • 变换你的语调和音量 1 从小组中选一名代表向全班发表演讲。

ex.s: Dunhuang has once again become a global crossroads since it hosted hundreds of representatives from over 51 countries for the Silk Road International Cultural Expo in 2017.
ex.t: 自2017年敦煌举办丝绸之路国际文化博览会、接待了来自51个以上国家的数百名代表以来，敦煌再次成为全球交汇点。

ex.s: New Mexico: Learn more about Native American arts, crafts and traditions by participating in the Gathering of Nations, the largest gathering in North America with representatives from hundreds of tribes.
ex.t: 新墨西哥州：参加"民族聚会"来了解更多关于美洲原住民的艺术、手工艺和传统，这是北美最大的聚会，有来自数百个部落的代表参加。

defs.def: containing or including examples of all the different types of people or things in a large group 代表各类人（或事物）的
able to be used as a typical example of sth 可作为典型（或示例）的
consisting of people who have been chosen to speak or vote on behalf of the rest of a group 政治体制等
